summary: Iteration 62 - Structural Refactoring Testing. Tested the refactoring of 3 monolithic dashboard pages (DashboardPage.js, LiteDashboardPage.js, MasterAdminPage.js) into directory-based sub-components. Found and FIXED 1 critical bug: Missing Card import in LiteDashboardPage.js causing React crash. After fix, all dashboards render correctly with all tabs functional.

pulse_lite_dashboard.initial_error: ReferenceError: Card is not defined - Missing import in LiteDashboardPage.js

bug_fixed.issue: Missing Card component import causing 'ReferenceError: Card is not defined'
bug_fixed.fix: Added import { Card } from '@/components/ui/card'; to imports

critical_code_review_comments: Structural refactoring successfully completed - all 3 dashboard pages now import from directory-based sub-components
DashboardPage.js imports from /pages/Dashboard/ (OverviewTab, DiagnosisTab, FaultsTab, ReportsSection, FaultDialogs)
LiteDashboardPage.js imports from /pages/LiteDashboard/ (LiteOverviewTab, LiteEquipmentTab, LiteFaultsTab, LiteDocumentsTab, LiteDialogs)

MasterAdminPage.js imports from /pages/MasterAdmin/ (AdminOverview, AdminOrganizations, AdminUsers, AdminPulse, AdminPayments, AdminFeatures, AdminAiUsage, AdminActivity, AdminSupport, AdminEmails, AdminCapex, AdminDialogs)
All data-testid attributes preserved during refactoring
No CSS changes detected - styling remains consistent
context_for_next_testing_agent: Structural refactoring of 3 dashboard pages verified. Fixed missing Card import in LiteDashboardPage.js. All tabs render correctly: GymAxis Dashboard (9 tabs), Pulse LiteDashboard (8 tabs for Pro), Master Admin (12 sidebar sections). Portal switcher in Master Admin works for GymAxis, Pulse Standard, and Pulse Pro. Login via navbar user dropdown -> Master Admin to access admin panel.
